explanation: Methodology moves out of the explorer into its own page-level view, MethodologyView.tsx (renamed from MethodologyTab.tsx), rendered in PageShell at #/methodology with a Home breadcrumb, so collection-wide methods no longer sit inside the macaque dataset. The audited content is unchanged by the move: collection-wide sections for source data, differential expression, enrichment, units and verification, then the macaque pipeline and size-cap example, with an On this page nav that scrolls in place and focuses the section. Significance defaults are read from DEFAULT_FDR_CUTOFF and METRIC_DEFAULT_SIG_THRESH. Audit corrections: tables replaced on 26 September 2026, session records per DE run, duplicate-symbol sum/average rules, log2(value + 1) matrix units, the 15-500 window applies to every study, KEGG legacy, and e33 dropping the parent term below i15's universe.
